messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident triggered - urgency: high. Source: az3 control-plane heartbeat loss detected. Pager: Maria (oncall).
Maria (oncall): acked. jumping in. key facts?
PagerDuty: Incident 14982 acknowledged by Maria (oncall). Escalation suppressed.
Aj: seeing healthcheck flaps from az3 control-plane between 02:12-02:16 UTC. spike in control RPC timeouts.
Maria (oncall): are we seeing customer errors? any 5xx for generation endpoints?
Support Ops: monitoring shows increased 5xx for eu-west customers pinned to az3 routes ~2.5% -> 8% 02:14-02:18, mostly short-lived timeouts.
Leo: infra-bot traced agent logs, found node kube-heartbeat process restarting due to OOM on control plane pod group cp-az3.
Sam: confirming autoscaler didn't kick because control plane healthchecks were failing; dataplane still accepting requests but routing decisions stuck.
Maria (oncall): ok we should trigger routing divert to prevent customer impact. Aj, can you run the manual route-divert to eu-west fallback pool?
Aj: running command now: ``/ops/divert --region eu-west --from az3 --to eu-west-fallback --reason \"cp-heartbeat-loss\"``
infra-bot: route-divert initiated. Traffic shift target: eu-west-fallback. Expected shift time ~30s.
Maria (oncall): toggling canary at 10% then ramp if stable.
Support Ops: metrics: 5xx rate starting to drop after 60s of divert. latency stable on fallback.
PagerDuty: Incident escalated to SRE lead Sam due to duration > 10m.
Sam: on it, spinning up control-plane warm pods in az3 with lower memory config to avoid immediate OOM. Deploy command: ``kubectl apply -f cp-az3-warm-canary.yaml``
Leo: logs show garbage collector spike before OOM. suspect memory leak in heartbeat aggregator -> collecting heap dump.
Maria (oncall): collecting customer impact notes: affected customers: subset of eu-west dedicated and some hosted routes; observed transient 5xx and elevated latencies for ~6 minutes before divert.
Sam: warm-pods applied, pods come up in ~45s. healthchecks passing for new pods.
infra-bot: control-plane heartbeat restored in az3 at 02:20:30 UTC. Old pods marked crashloop; new warm pods healthy.
Aj: routing team reports automated divert completed successfully and traffic backfilled to az3 at ~02:21 after stabilization tests. No rollback required.
Maria (oncall): marking incident as mitigated. preparing summary: cause = control-plane pod OOM (heap GC spike) -> route decision stall -> partial customer 5xx -> manual divert -> deploy warm pods -> restore.
Support Ops: capturing affected customer list and times for postmortem. will open support tickets for those with SLA impact.
PagerDuty: Incident 14982 status changed to mitigated by Maria (oncall). Awaiting postmortem.
Sam: next actions: set pod memory limit bump on cp-az3, enable earlier OOM alert for heartbeat restarts, add heap dump-on-OOM instrumentation.
Leo: will add GC tuning and enable a synthetic heartbeat probe that bypasses aggregator to detect controller stall early.
Maria (oncall): creating incident doc and assigning owners: Sam -> root cause & deploy fix, Leo -> monitoring/alerting, Aj -> routing automation to allow auto-divert on control-plane stalls.
Maria (oncall): thanks all. assigning follow-up meeting tomorrow 09:30 UTC to finalize runbook changes. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Note: this thread will be archived into incidents log.
